verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. A partner step preserves the unordered multiset of side lengths and the positive area. For any fixed cyclic ordering of those side lengths, the area and diagonal identities reduce the possible angle data to the intersection of a genuine line with a circle, yielding at most two possibilities; SSS and convex gluing then give at most one congruence class per possibility. Since there are finitely many cyclic orderings, only finitely many congruence classes can occur. The statement is self-contained, no hard prohibition is triggered, and no external or fact-graph references require checking.
